Ms. Kanchan Tanaji Pawar for the Petitioner.
Smt. M. P. Thakur, Agp for the Respondent-State.

Coram : Sandeep V. Marne &
 Dr. Neela Gokhale, Jj.
(Vacation Court) Dated : 15th May 2024.

The Petitioner is a 27 years old sexual assault survivor, who is about 25 weeks and
6 days pregnant.

It is stated in the petition that the pregnant person is a sexual assault survivor and an First Information Report No. 315/2024 is registered at Ganeshpuri Police Station, Thane Rural, Thane under Section 376(2)(n)(f ), 420 &
504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Since the pregnant person has completed more than 25 weeks and 6 days, she seeks permission to terminate her pregnancy.
3. We thus request the authorities of the City Hospital at Thane to constitute a Medical Board as required under the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 to examine the victim urgently.
